description: Decode data byte-exactly through every layer (hex, base64, PEM, JWT, dumps, gzip/zlib/zstd, DER/ASN.1, CBOR, MessagePack, schemaless protobuf) and return a JSON tree with byte ranges. Ambiguous protobuf LEN fields list ranked alternatives (message, string, bytes, packed); 64-bit integers are JSON strings. Long text and bytes are previewed ("truncated":true); use get with format raw for a full payload. Paths: protobuf field numbers (1.3[2].4: the third field 3 of message 1), DER child indices (0.0.5), a PEM bundle's block index first, CBOR/MessagePack map keys and array indices (users.0.name), a JWT part then JSON keys (payload.sub), JSON keys and indices inside decoded JSON text (users.37.id). Paths cross formats: 2.0.0.5 is the subject of a certificate (base64, PEM or raw DER) held in protobuf field 2.

alts.description: Max interpretations kept per protobuf LEN field (default 3).

as.description: Force how the innermost decoded bytes are interpreted, when auto-detection picks wrongly.

depth.description: Max nesting of layers and messages (default 16).

file.description: Path of a local file to read instead of input (binary files are fine).

format.description: json (default); tree: a compact indented outline; raw: the selected item's payload bytes as lowercase hex (needs get).

get.description: Select one item by path and return only it.

in.description: How to read the input (default auto). raw = the bytes as they are.

input.description: The data as text: hex, base64, PEM, a JWT, an xxd or hexdump -C dump, or any nesting of these. Give either input or file.

max_items.description: Max protobuf fields, CBOR/MessagePack values and DER elements decoded in total (default 1000000).

output_file.description: Write the result to this file instead of returning it. Fails if the file exists, unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Allow output_file to replace an existing file.

name: peel
title: Decode data
